purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel sources for Butuan, Philippines; claims are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Butuan

queries.query: Butuan Philippines official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party results identified the official Butuan City land-use planning pages, the national Geoportal Philippines map, the LMB Parcel data layer, and LRA cadastral-map procedure material. No city-specific public parcel feature response was established.

queries.query: Butuan mapa sa mga parsela yuta cadastre GIS rehistro yuta opisyal
queries.result: The official Butuan City result in Cebuano documented the city Comprehensive Land Use Plan and City Planning and Development Department, but not parcel-level geometry or a public cadastral API. The national Geoportal remained the only observed public parcel-layer route.

officialSources.observation: The live public Geoportal Philippines viewer exposes an LMB layer titled Parcel data. Its current JavaScript loads layers from /layers/fetchlayers and configures the public WMS at https://geoserver.geoportal.gov.ph/geoserver/geoportal/wms. The layer metadata identifies the national source as LMB, but does not by itself prove Butuan citywide coverage.
Official Butuan City page publishes city development plans and terms for city data/maps; this is local planning custodian evidence, not a parcel geometry service.
Official Land Registration Authority citizen-charter material references cadastral maps/previous approved plans in registry procedures; it does not expose an anonymous Butuan parcel API.

requests.method: GET viewer HTML and current JavaScript/configuration
requests.outcome: Anonymous public viewer loaded. Current script was inspected and showed the layer endpoint and GeoServer WMS URL. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or private token was used.
Returned the current layer catalog; bounded inspection found agency LMB, layer_name denr_parcel_data, title Parcel data. Native schema and CRS were not supplied by this catalog response.

requests.method: GET bounded anonymous GetFeatureInfo around exact WUP point
requests.outcome: Request timed out after 20 seconds with no response. This is not evidence of a parcel miss or citywide absence.
Request timed out after 30 seconds with no response; no schema or CRS was inferred.

registryBasis: The national LMB parcel layer and Butuan City planning custodian were evidenced, but no local Butuan registry/cadastre procedure or city-specific parcel service was independently verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National Geoportal exposes an LMB Parcel data layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Layer catalog presence only; no bounded Butuan parcel feature response, schema, CRS, or citywide completeness was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The public Geoportal WMS may serve parcel geometry when responsive or through a different bounded viewer request. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. A timeout is not evidence of citywide absence.
